newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light at $112/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light at $112/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not well tested on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), but a few sales were $1.00-$2.00 per cwt lower, according to USDA.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 112.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 112.00.
Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on a live basis. Demand was limited and seller interest was modest.

For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were steady to 1.00 lower; dressed basis fully 1.00 lower. Weekly total includes 16,200 formulated and previously contracted cattle.
